source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 1.7 (PDF 14-15), paragraph for paragraph, with two self-checks and a recap.

blocks.text: Network protocol baat-cheet ke qawaid (rules) ka majmua hai. Yeh tay karta hai ke data kis shakal (format) mein aur kaise bheja jaye. Protocols ghaltiyon ko sambhalna aur data ki delivery control karte hain. Network ke tamam devices ko ek hi protocol par chalna zaroori hai. Protocols data ka len-den hamwaar banate hain. Misaalein: TCP/IP aur HTTP.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Protocols un zabanon ki tarah hain jin mein computers aapas mein baat karte hain.
Transmission Control Protocol aur Internet Protocol (TCP/IP)

TCP/IP ka matlab hai Transmission Control Protocol aur Internet Protocol. Yeh Internet par istemal hone wala sab se ahem protocol hai. TCP yaqeeni banata hai ke data bharose se pohanche. IP data ki addressing (pata dena) aur routing (raasta chunna) sambhalta hai. Dono mil kar devices ke darmiyan baat-cheet mumkin banate hain. Yeh taqreeban har network mein istemal hota hai.

HTTP ka matlab hai Hypertext Transfer Protocol. Yeh web pages bhejne ke liye istemal hota hai. HTTP web browser aur web server ke darmiyan kaam karta hai. Is se users websites dekh sakte hain. HTTP data ko encrypt (khufia) nahi karta; is liye mehfooz websites is ki jagah HTTPS istemal karti hain. HTTPS, HTTP ka mehfooz version hai. Yeh web browser aur web server ke darmiyan jane wale data ko encryption se bachata hai. Yeh encryption SSL/TLS protocols deti hain, jo yaqeeni banati hain ke passwords, zaati maloomat aur payment ka data hamla karne wale aasani se raaste mein pakar (intercept) na sakein.

FTP ka matlab hai File Transfer Protocol. Yeh files upload aur download karne ke liye istemal hota hai. FTP computers ke darmiyan files share karne deta hai. Web developers ise aam istemal karte hain. FTP bari files bhi bhej sakta hai. FTP ke mehfooz versions bhi maujood hain.

DNS ka matlab hai Domain Name System. Yeh website ke naam ko IP address mein badalta hai. DNS websites tak pohanchna aasan banata hai (jaise Figure 1.14 mein). Users ko numbers yaad rakhne ki zaroorat nahi. DNS servers yeh tarjuma (translation) karte hain. Internet ke istemal mein is ka bara kirdar hai.

blocks.alt: DNS name resolution aik qatar mein: screen par www.example.com, teer se DNS likha globe, teer se badal (cloud) mein server, aur teer se IP address 93.184.216.34.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.14: DNS ke zariye naam se IP address tak pohanchne ka amal (kitab ki Figure 1.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Jab bhi koi website kholi jati hai, DNS parde ke peeche kaam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Web pages dekhne ke liye kaun sa protocol use hota hai, aur mehfooz websites is ke bajaye HTTPS kyun use karti hain?
blocks.explanation: HTTP. Yeh data be-encryption bhejta hai, is liye mehfooz websites HTTPS use karti hain jo SSL/TLS se data encrypt karta hai taake passwords aur payment ki tafseelat asani se churai na ja sakein.
Domain names (jaise www.example.com) ko un IP addresses mein badalna jin se computers aik doosre ko dhoondte hain.

items: Protocol: data ke format aur bhejne ke mushtarka qawaid.
TCP/IP: TCP bharose wali delivery, IP addressing aur routing.
HTTP: web pages (HTTPS SSL/TLS se encrypted); FTP: files; DNS: naam se IP address.
